title: SIDE MOUNTED EXHAUST-FILLER PANEL & TRIMMING PROCEDURE
summary: RPO N14 side mounted exhaust (side pipes): a special rear lower filler panel (rear valance/filler under the rear bumper area) and rear quarter panel with a bonded flange are used, and the front fender and rocker lower edges are trimmed to clear the side pipe. The filler panel is held with production screws, bolts and washers plus a nut; the quarter panel lower front corner takes a bolt. Note: N14 was cancelled for 1970 (see N14 A1).

parts.name: REAR QUARTER PANEL
parts.name_expanded: Rear quarter panel (LH/RH), side exhaust version

parts.name: BOLT
parts.name_expanded: Bolt – rear quarter panel lower front

fastening.note: View A: filler panel [1] is held by production screw & lock washer at its middle and a production bolt, lock washer & washer at its inboard end (production fasteners, no callouts).
View A: nut [2] at the outboard flange of the filler panel [1].
View A: flange [3] is bonded to the quarter panel (BOND "B"); no material legend on this sheet.

fastening.to: lower front of rear quarter panel
fastening.note: View A: bolt [5] goes in from outside at the lower front corner of the quarter panel [4]; mating part not shown.
